scores.thoughts: The bill mandates FAA rulemaking, GAO reviews, IG audits, and various agency reports/coordination. These activities may entail minor administrative costs but do not expand or reduce overall government spending programs or appropriations. No direct fiscal provisions appear.
The bill contains no provisions related to tax policy, rates, credits, or revenue measures.
No provisions address healthcare delivery, coverage, regulation, or funding.
No provisions relate to firearms, gun ownership, or related regulations.
No provisions address immigration, visas, borders, or enforcement.
No provisions address reproductive rights or abortion access.
The bill requires DoD/FAA coordination, Army IG audits, and updates to MOUs on ADS-B exceptions for military flights, but it does not alter defense spending levels, procurement, or force structure.
No provisions address environmental regulations, emissions, or climate policy.
No provisions address welfare programs, entitlements, or social services.
No provisions address schools, education funding, or federal education policy.
No provisions address drug enforcement, decriminalization, or related policy.
No provisions address sentencing, policing, or criminal justice reform.
No provisions address tariffs, trade agreements, or globalization.
No provisions address deficit spending, debt ceilings, or fiscal balance.
No provisions address LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
No provisions address foreign assistance or international aid.
No provisions address voting access, election integrity, or electoral processes.
The bill mandates aviation surveillance technology (ADS-B In/Out) but contains no data-privacy, surveillance oversight, or tech-regulation provisions outside aviation safety.
The bill references collective-bargaining representatives in stakeholder consultations but does not alter union rights, worker protections, or employer flexibility.
No provisions address religious exemptions or anti-discrimination law.
